# === QUANTIZATION LEGEND (I only use these) ==================================
Q8_0  → highest quality, ~1.2× slower
Q6_K  → sweet spot (my default)
Q5_K_M → still great coherence
Q5_K_S → faster, still readable
Q4_K_M → 90–110 t/s on 4090
Q4_0   → fastest, still usable

# === INFERENCE ENGINES I TRUST (ranked by speed on my hardware) ==============
1. llama.cpp (latest git, CUDA + cuBLAS 12.5)      ← fastest everything
2. Ollama (with llama.cpp backend)
3. LM Studio (Windows GUI, zero config)
4. TabbyAPI + ExLlamaV2 (for 70B Q4)
5. vLLM 0.6.2 (for API serving)
6. Text-generation-webui + ExLlamaV2 (legacy but comfy)

# === APIs I use daily (keys in .env, never hard-coded) =======================
Groq (Llama-3.1-70B @ 800 t/s) → https://console.groq.com
Together.ai (Mixtral-8x22B, Qwen2-72B)
Fireworks.ai (Llama-3.1-405B @ Q4)
OpenRouter (fallback + routing)
Perplexity Sonar-Pro + Deep Research (for web search)
Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Opus 4.1 (for final polish)
OpenAI GPT-4o-2025-08-06 + o1-pro (when I’m lazy)

# === RAG / TOOL USE STACK (what actually works in 2025) ======================
- LlamaIndex 0.11 + llama.cpp backend
- Haystack 2.5 + Weaviate 1.26
- LangChain 0.3 only when forced
- LiteLLM proxy → unified interface for 40+ providers

- LitGPT (for full fine-tunes)
